OKC Thunder point guard Ajay Mitchell is no stranger to making an impact off the bench. Since bursting onto the scene as the team's primary substitute in 2025-26, he has provided a spark every time his name is called. After finishing fifth in Sixth Man of the Year voting last season, Mitchell has his sights set on taking the crown this year.
